alt.title: Alternative data
alt.summary: Non-price signals such as US congressional trade disclosures, committees, and filings.

book.title: Investment book
book.summary: Strategies, themes, and trade ideas written by portfolio managers. Reserved; no data is collected yet.

broker.title: Broker mirror
broker.summary: Positions, executions, orders, and cash flows mirrored from broker accounts. Reserved; no data is collected yet.

derived.title: Derived research
derived.summary: Reproducible computed outputs such as factors and forward-test attribution. Reserved; no data is computed yet.

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals
fundamentals.summary: Point-in-time company filings and financial statement line items. Reserved; no data is collected yet.

market.title: Market data
market.summary: Price and volume bars for India and US listings, including India single-stock futures contracts.

meta.title: Data operations
meta.summary: How collection is running: every ingestion run, the series we expect, daily coverage, recovery progress, and source health.

raw.title: Raw archive
raw.summary: The untouched vendor responses every curated row was built from, kept for audit and replay.

ref.title: Reference
ref.summary: The shared dictionary: countries, exchanges, companies, securities, listings, contracts, and identifier mappings.

research.title: Research views
research.summary: Read-only views that apply point-in-time rules over the stored tables.

risk.title: Risk
risk.summary: Risk budgets set by the risk function. Reserved; no data is collected yet.

book.attribution.title: Trade attribution
book.attribution.summary: Reserved for linking each execution to the trade idea it belongs to. No data is collected yet.

book.strategies.title: Strategies
book.strategies.summary: Reserved for the trading strategies run through broker accounts. No data is collected yet.

book.themes.title: Investment themes
book.themes.summary: Reserved for the themes portfolio managers invest behind. No data is collected yet.

book.trade_legs.title: Trade legs
book.trade_legs.summary: Reserved for the target positions that make up each trade idea. No data is collected yet.

book.trade_names.title: Trade ideas
book.trade_names.summary: Reserved for named investment ideas and their thesis. No data is collected yet.

broker.account_state_snapshot.title: Account snapshots
broker.account_state_snapshot.summary: Reserved for broker account values such as net liquidation and buying power over time. No data is collected yet.

broker.applied_corporate_actions.title: Applied corporate actions
broker.applied_corporate_actions.summary: Reserved for splits and dividends as they affected each account. No data is collected yet.

broker.cash_flows.title: Cash flows
broker.cash_flows.summary: Reserved for dividends, interest, fees, deposits, and withdrawals per account. No data is collected yet.

broker.executions.title: Executions
broker.executions.summary: Reserved for every fill reported by the broker. No data is collected yet.

broker.open_orders_snapshot.title: Open orders
broker.open_orders_snapshot.summary: Reserved for snapshots of unfilled orders. No data is collected yet.

broker.order_events.title: Order events
broker.order_events.summary: Reserved for the full life cycle of each order: placed, modified, cancelled, filled. No data is collected yet.

broker.positions_snapshot.title: Positions
broker.positions_snapshot.summary: Reserved for position snapshots per broker account. No data is collected yet.

derived.computations.title: Computations
derived.computations.summary: Reserved for a record of each reproducible computation run. No data is computed yet.

derived.factors.title: Factors
derived.factors.summary: Reserved for computed factor values per listing and date. No data is computed yet.

derived.forward_test_attribution.title: Forward-test attribution
derived.forward_test_attribution.summary: Reserved for scoring paper-trading results against their backtests. No data is computed yet.

fundamentals.filings.title: Company filings
fundamentals.filings.summary: Reserved for regulatory filings such as 10-K and 10-Q headers. No data is collected yet.

fundamentals.line_items.title: Financial line items
fundamentals.line_items.summary: Reserved for individual values from financial statements, as first reported. No data is collected yet.

ref.session_windows_effective.title: Effective session windows
ref.session_windows_effective.summary: A view that combines trading sessions with holiday overrides to give each exchange's actual hours.

risk.budgets.title: Risk budgets
risk.budgets.summary: Reserved for exposure and loss limits at each level of the fund. No data is collected yet.

alt.political_committee_memberships.title: Committee memberships
alt.political_committee_memberships.summary: Which member of Congress sits on which committee, with their role, as dated periods (a row is current while effective_to is empty).

alt.political_committees.title: Congressional committees
alt.political_committees.summary: House and Senate committees and subcommittees, with jurisdiction and links, per Congress.

alt.political_filings.title: Disclosure filings
alt.political_filings.summary: One row per House financial disclosure filing (periodic transaction reports, annual reports, amendments), with a link to the original document.

alt.political_trades.title: Congressional trades
alt.political_trades.summary: Individual securities trades disclosed by members of Congress, with the disclosed amount range, who owned the asset, and the matched ticker or company when it could be resolved.
notes: Amounts are disclosed as ranges; use amount_min and amount_max rather than a single value.
transaction_date is when the trade happened; filing_date is when it was disclosed, often weeks later.
listing_id is empty when the asset could not be matched confidently; check resolution_confidence.

columns.owner_code: Whose account held the asset: self, spouse, joint, or a dependent child.
columns.ticker_raw: The ticker exactly as written in the filing, before any matching.

alt.social_reddit_posts.title: Reddit posts
alt.social_reddit_posts.summary: Reserved for social media posts that mention listed securities. No data is collected yet.

market.bars.title: Price bars
market.bars.summary: Open, high, low, close, and volume for every collected listing: India NSE equities every minute, and US equities every minute and every day.
notes: Filter by resolution: 1-minute and daily bars are stored in the same table.
bar_time is the start of the bar in UTC; trade_date is the local trading day.
Prices are in the listing's own currency (INR for India, USD for the US).
Volume is shares for equities; do not add it across different product types.

columns.country_code: IN for India, US for the United States.
columns.listing_id: The listing's FactorLab ID; look it up in ref.listings for the symbol and exchange.
columns.bar_time: When the bar starts, in UTC.
columns.trade_date: The local trading day the bar belongs to.
columns.source: The data vendor, e.g. upstox or schwab.
columns.raw_id: The raw.archive response this bar was parsed from.

market.futures_contract_bars.title: Futures contract bars
market.futures_contract_bars.summary: 1-minute bars for individual India single-stock futures contracts, one series per contract and expiry, with open interest.
notes: Each contract is a separate series; no continuous roll is applied.
Look up the contract's expiry and underlying in ref.contracts.

columns.contract_id: The futures contract's FactorLab ID in ref.contracts.
columns.underlying_listing_id: The stock the future is written on, in ref.listings.
columns.oi: Open interest: contracts outstanding at the end of the bar.

market.futures_continuous.title: Continuous futures
market.futures_continuous.summary: Reserved for rolled front- and back-month futures series. Not computed yet.

market.fx_rates.title: Currency rates
market.fx_rates.summary: Reserved for foreign exchange rate bars used to convert between currencies. No data is collected yet.

market.options_bars.title: Options bars
market.options_bars.summary: Reserved for option contract price bars with greeks. No data is collected yet.

market.quotes.title: Quotes
market.quotes.summary: Reserved for bid and ask quotes, built when trade execution needs them. No data is collected yet.

meta.expected_series.title: Collection plan
meta.expected_series.summary: Every price series FactorLab is set up to collect, by country, source, and bar length, and whether it is currently active.
notes: active = true means the series is collected today; inactive rows are kept for history.

meta.expected_series_canonical.title: Collection plan (pre-cutover copy)
meta.expected_series_canonical.summary: A frozen copy of the collection plan from before the v2 cutover on 24 September 2026. Nothing writes to it.

meta.hub_schema_layouts.title: Schema map layouts
meta.hub_schema_layouts.summary: Saved positions of tables on the hub's schema map canvas.

meta.ingestion_runs.title: Ingestion runs
meta.ingestion_runs.summary: One row per collection run: which pipeline ran, when, whether it succeeded, how many series and rows it handled, and any error.
notes: A run first appears as running and is then updated to success, partial, failed, or cancelled.
US history pipelines record one run per symbol, so they produce many rows.

columns.pipeline: The collection job, e.g. india_intraday_1min or us_live.
columns.status: running, success, partial, failed, or cancelled.
columns.rows_written: Rows the run inserted into curated tables.
columns.error: Why the run failed or was partial, when it did.

meta.lineage.title: Row lineage
meta.lineage.summary: Links curated rows back to the raw responses and computations that produced them.

meta.migration_id_crosswalk.title: Migration ID map
meta.migration_id_crosswalk.summary: How identifiers from the legacy database were mapped to v2 IDs during the migration.

meta.migration_political_trade_enrichmen.title: Migration political enrichment
meta.migration_political_trade_enrichmen.summary: Reviewed corrections applied to political trades while migrating them to v2.

meta.migration_reference_enrichment.title: Migration reference enrichment
meta.migration_reference_enrichment.summary: Reviewed exchange and currency details applied to reference data during the v2 migration.

meta.migration_runs.title: Migration runs
meta.migration_runs.summary: Each run of the v2 migration tool and its outcome.

meta.reconciliation_drift.title: Broker reconciliation drift
meta.reconciliation_drift.summary: Reserved for differences detected between FactorLab and broker records. No data is collected yet.

meta.recovery_state.title: History recovery
meta.recovery_state.summary: For each series, how far back history has been loaded, whether it is complete, and the last recovery error.

columns.history_complete: True once the full available history has been loaded.
columns.checked_through: The latest time coverage has been verified up to.

meta.recovery_state_canonical.title: History recovery (pre-cutover copy)
meta.recovery_state_canonical.summary: A frozen copy of recovery progress from before the v2 cutover. Nothing writes to it.

meta.schema_migrations.title: Schema migrations
meta.schema_migrations.summary: Each schema file applied to the v2 databases, with its checksum and status.

meta.session_coverage.title: Daily coverage
meta.session_coverage.summary: For each series and trading day, how many bars were expected, how many were collected, and how many are missing.

meta.session_coverage_canonical.title: Daily coverage (pre-cutover copy)
meta.session_coverage_canonical.summary: A frozen copy of daily coverage from before the v2 cutover. Nothing writes to it.

meta.source_status.title: Source health
meta.source_status.summary: The latest status each data source reported, such as ready, recovering, or waiting for sign-in, with details.

meta.unresolved_entities.title: Unmatched identifiers
meta.unresolved_entities.summary: Vendor identifiers that could not yet be matched to a FactorLab company, security, or listing, with how often they appeared.

raw.archive.title: Raw vendor responses
raw.archive.summary: Every HTTP response FactorLab received from a data vendor, kept unchanged so curated data can be audited and rebuilt.
notes: Response bodies and headers are not shown in the hub; URLs are shown without query strings.

ref.adjustment_factors.title: Price adjustment factors
ref.adjustment_factors.summary: Reserved for split and dividend adjustment factors per listing. Not computed yet.

ref.broker_accounts.title: Broker accounts
ref.broker_accounts.summary: Reserved for the broker accounts FactorLab mirrors. No data is collected yet.

ref.broker_metrics_map.title: Broker metric names
ref.broker_metrics_map.summary: Reserved mapping from broker-specific metric names to FactorLab's standard names.

ref.contracts.title: Derivative contracts
ref.contracts.summary: Futures and options contracts, with their underlying listing, expiry, lot size, and multiplier.

ref.corporate_actions.title: Corporate actions
ref.corporate_actions.summary: Reserved for splits, dividends, mergers, and ticker changes. No data is collected yet.

ref.countries.title: Countries
ref.countries.summary: Countries FactorLab covers, with their default currency and time zone.

ref.currencies.title: Currencies
ref.currencies.summary: ISO currency codes used across FactorLab.

ref.dataset_versions.title: Dataset versions
ref.dataset_versions.summary: Reserved for recording when a curated dataset's methodology changes.

ref.entities.title: Companies and people
ref.entities.summary: Issuers, companies, members of Congress, committees, and other organizations, each with a stable FactorLab ID.

ref.entity_relationships.title: Entity relationships
ref.entity_relationships.summary: Reserved for mergers, spin-offs, renames, and parent–subsidiary links between entities.

ref.exchanges.title: Exchanges
ref.exchanges.summary: Stock exchanges and trading venues, with their ISO market code (MIC), country, currency, and time zone.

ref.execution_methods.title: Execution methods
ref.execution_methods.summary: Reserved list of how orders are placed (API service, manual, algorithm).

ref.holidays.title: Market holidays
ref.holidays.summary: Exchange holidays and special sessions. Not populated yet.

ref.identifier_aliases.title: Identifier mappings
ref.identifier_aliases.summary: Maps every vendor code (tickers, ISINs, Upstox instrument keys, Bioguide IDs, and more) to the FactorLab ID it refers to, with validity dates.

columns.alias_kind: The kind of code, e.g. ticker, isin, or upstox_instrument_key.
columns.target_id: The FactorLab ID it maps to.

ref.legislator_terms.title: Congressional terms
ref.legislator_terms.summary: Each member of Congress's terms in office, with chamber, state, district, and party.

ref.listing_migrations.title: Listing moves
ref.listing_migrations.summary: Reserved for securities that moved between exchanges or were relisted.

ref.listings.title: Listings
ref.listings.summary: Every tradable listing: a security on a specific exchange, with its trading symbol. This is the ID that price data uses.
notes: Join market.bars.listing_id to ref.listings.listing_id to get symbols and exchanges.

columns.trading_symbol: The symbol traders use, e.g. AAPL or TCS.
columns.active: Whether the listing is currently trading.

ref.sectors.title: Sectors
ref.sectors.summary: Reserved for industry classifications such as GICS. Not populated yet.

ref.securities.title: Securities
ref.securities.summary: The instruments themselves (a company's common stock, an ETF, a future), independent of where they trade.

ref.sessions.title: Trading sessions
ref.sessions.summary: Reserved for exchange trading hours by day of week. Not populated yet.

ref.sources.title: Data sources
ref.sources.summary: The vendors and feeds FactorLab collects from.

ref.universe_membership.title: Universe membership
ref.universe_membership.summary: Reserved for which listings belonged to an index or universe on each date.

ref.universes.title: Universes
ref.universes.summary: Reserved for index and watchlist definitions such as the S&P 500 or NIFTY 50.

research.bars.title: Point-in-time bars
research.bars.summary: Price bars as they were known on a chosen date. Query it with an asof_date parameter.

research.owned_listings.title: Owned listings
research.owned_listings.summary: Listings held in broker accounts on a given date, for joining against other data.

research.political_trades.title: Point-in-time political trades
research.political_trades.summary: Congressional trades as they had been disclosed by a chosen date.

research.universe_membership.title: Point-in-time universes
research.universe_membership.summary: Universe members as of a chosen date.
